While there is no direct chemical interaction listed between them, combining alcohol and prednisone increases overlapping side effects and can worsen the condition you are treating.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF1wcYkYlBAHkaomFAeZqRRJGY2n7nH5SliL3UpkiVUf8U9kEJsuhoZ3rCauB3FdFLRhTFmYjMqqbLLd031MIpOIpmj-73WsukVTLSc6XNTx16r9iJ3EST5pF-KdztqLpFT7VNOez6BaukAAQG0KXxnOUItN_AfxcAno1uvJS6WLvBjw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXSJYdaozFOHazaNrTsLq2HRf_Tq2hdCpAQF1rkS4HSoyvlWEOjYLlntvIwRNR5MeUvCneuNMLk06Kxw6C3g5_VLMBmou3-rRgsHgQT1HMiJbNv4as9QzVUyIvNZ9JDV9hfKoPc6H8LQ56b1Y)

- **Stomach irritation and ulcers:** Both can irritate the stomach lining. - **Weakened immune system:** Both prednisone and alcohol suppress immune defenses, making infections harder to fight or recover from.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXSJYdaozFOHazaNrTsLq2HRf_Tq2hdCpAQF1rkS4HSoyvlWEOjYLlntvIwRNR5MeUvCneuNMLk06Kxw6C3g5_VLMBmou3-rRgsHgQT1HMiJbNv4as9QzVUyIvNZ9JDV9hfKoPc6H8LQ56b1Y)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXAlUhTPC9tK_2ksnHhO-JpCR-VEx9r3gaNtADj5xIC2WFPMzr5XfHXW8vRDvCqVfuVvOpLkrmIwBVJRJQtMC-smAu5Sxl_lJswxPoEuw5yv8VMwJx9khbKpCCthlUCpX6x4bWoq_1_VlJf83ZdFcBQp1WH9cgcmszAA)
- **Blood sugar swings:** Prednisone can raise blood sugar, while alcohol can cause unpredictable fluctuations.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXaHA7jo6xiWVqvR_xBRmxIPFZFiklmArNVvjf2MYcya5tPnoXcqVPDucfZIPpViNeZvjJ7b6g_FjAvUcmBbrZcDtcx4iEb-QMEGpXRyon4lWpnXZUtvS9XwGcPLWsAFgySC5W-5m9mBR93Q)
- **Mood and sleep changes:** Both can contribute to mood swings, anxiety, irritability, and disrupted sleep.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShAEBxCJF13lcB0CvKg--YUjfHZRF4LlVbwKTl4mbj03jjuoWt0IsbGIMEnX22ZWQgtdSqXRUTHpJ6L-pDJako7wKj7NMeufByF66OGuWeyGP-voWzLutPP2zgC4lUjegE-rZKKZyuO-6EAqlPlo--pvsc_3YWBk9HAen0UFbvf8ralBBzZE)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXaHA7jo6xiWVqvR_xBRmxIPFZFiklmArNVvjf2MYcya5tPnoXcqVPDucfZIPpViNeZvjJ7b6g_FjAvUcmBbrZcDtcx4iEb-QMEGpXRyon4lWpnXZUtvS9XwGcPLWsAFgySC5W-5m9mBR93Q)
